sections.title: General Instructions
points: The clock will be set at the server. The countdown timer at the top of the screen will display the remaining time available for you to complete the examination. When the timer reaches zero, the examination will end by itself.

The Question Palette displayed on the right side of screen will show the status of each question using one of the following symbols: Not Visited, Not Answered, Answered, Marked for Review, Answered and Marked for Review.
You can click on the ">" arrow which appears to the left of the question palette to collapse it. Click "<" to view it again.
You can click on your profile image on the top right of the screen to change language, or log out.

sections.title: Navigating to a Question
points: Click on the question number in the Question Palette to go to that question directly.
You can use Next / Previous to move between questions.
Flag / Mark for Review is for your convenience and does not mean evaluation.

sections.title: Answering a Question
points: For multiple choice questions, select one option by clicking the radio button.
To change the answer, click another option.
To deselect, click the selected option again (if allowed) or use Clear Response.
To save your answer, click Save & Next.
For numerical questions, enter the answer using the on-screen numeric keypad / keyboard.

sections.title: Marking Scheme (JEE Main style)
points: Single Correct: +4 for correct, −1 for incorrect, 0 for unattempted (unless mentioned otherwise on the paper).
Numerical / Integer type: +4 for correct, 0 for incorrect/unattempted (standard JEE Main numerical scheme).
